description: Get actual search queries that triggered your ads (search term report). Shows what users are really searching for.

campaign_id.description: Optional: filter to a specific campaign ID

customer_id.description: Google Ads customer ID. Defaults to GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID env var

days.description: Number of days to look back

limit.description: Maximum rows to return (1-10000). Raise it to reach the long tail — e.g. when cross-referencing against Search Console data. Large values produce large responses

name: get_search_terms
